solution.title: Group Policy to Intune Settings Migration

products.name: Group Policy to Intune Settings Migration — Commercial
products.short_description: A structured migration from Active Directory Group Policy to Intune — inventory, translate to the settings catalog and ADMX policies, manage coexistence, and cut over by rings without losing settings that matter. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Move your Group Policy estate into Intune — translated, not guessed, with a safe cutover

Decades of Group Policy settings keep your domain-joined PCs in line — but they only apply on the corporate network, they don't follow cloud-joined and remote devices, and nobody fully knows what's in there anymore. This solution gives you a structured migration from Active Directory GPOs to Intune: inventory what you actually have, translate settings to the Intune settings catalog and ADMX-backed policies, manage coexistence so on-prem and cloud policy don't fight, and cut over by rings — without losing a setting that mattered.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how GPO and Intune policy differ, the settings catalog and imported ADMX model, the Group Policy analytics workflow, coexistence and precedence during migration, and the ring-based cutover.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, access to export GPOs, Group Policy analytics, target device groups, a rollback plan) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: export and inventory GPOs, run Group Policy analytics, map supported settings to settings-catalog/ADMX policies, handle unsupported settings, configure coexistence and precedence, assign in rings, then validate parity and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — GPO export/inventory discovery, settings-parity validation (GPO vs. Intune), a migration coverage and gap report, safe remediation of conflicts, and a migration-ring group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Your Group Policy estate translated into Intune — settings that matter preserved, coexistence managed during the move, and a ringed cutover that follows devices on or off the corporate network — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GPOM-Discovery.ps1 — export and inventory every Group Policy Object for migration
    • GPOM-Remediation.ps1 — safely resolve conflicting GPO/Intune policy precedence (-WhatIf default)
    • GPOM-Report.ps1 — migration coverage and gap report from the GPO exports
    • GPOM-Set-MigrationRingTargeting.ps1 — build the migration ring groups in Microsoft Entra (Graph)
    • GPOM-Validation.ps1 — settings parity check (GPO vs. applied Intune policy) on a device

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
